FN-KZYS5U-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 88
Committee: Economic Development & Sponsor: Representative Chris Sells
Tourism
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 03/27/2023
House Bill 88 as introduced provides for the donation and delivery of up to 4.5 liters of liquor
to a licensed nonprofit special event and requires such donation to be taxed in accordance with
state and federal laws, rules, and regulations. This bill will otherwise not directly affect state or
local funding.
